_about: Flaws in N1's tests found while labelling their runs (the review before the runs missed them). 'Flawed is flawed': these tests are counted as invalid in the results, like the ones the review found.
N1-BOX-T11: who added a hub item is not readable through the API the agent uses
removing a hub item returns 501 in the replica, so the expected removal is impossible
N1-CAL-T07: the actor may not rename a calendar whose data owner is Kenji (403), so the expected rename is impossible
N1-SLK-T03: the seed does not install: two people named Tom Becker get the same username (unique constraint)
